page.title: YouTube
page.description: Look up metadata for a YouTube video: title, author, description, duration, thumbnails, and (with an optional API key) view/like/comment counts.

welcomeScreen.title: YouTube Video Metadata
welcomeScreen.intro: Paste a YouTube video link above (youtube.com/watch, youtu.be, /shorts, or /embed) and look it up.
welcomeScreen.description: Title, author, description, duration, and thumbnails are fetched without an API key. Add a YouTube Data API key under Settings > API Keys to also see view/like/comment counts, tags, and category.

stats.title: Extended stats
stats.notConfigured: Add a YouTube Data API key under Settings > API Keys to see view/like/comment counts, tags, and category for this video.
stats.fetchFailed: The YouTube Data API request failed (invalid/quota-exceeded key, or the video isn't accessible via the API). Showing keyless data only.

thumbnails.title: Thumbnails
thumbnails.maxresHint: Higher resolutions (e.g. maxresdefault) may not exist for every video.
